name: Takayama Shizuka
source:
She lives in the apartment as well. She was a slut when she was younger but she never experienced an orgasm. She is a mischievous wife that is like a naughty older sister. She is the object of much adoration from the men in her neighborhood. She is the protagonist's neighbor, and she is friendly towards him.

The protagonist admires her, but can't talk to her well.
